# Alderyard Nurseries - pump house runtime log

logs/runtime.log takes one line per reading:

    <date> pump B runtime <h> h - pressure <bar> bar - operator <name>

Meter readings are kept in notes/; a reading is logged under its
sheet's date with the operator who signs the sheet.
